kilo-mcp-conflict-resolver.reason: Same class as the generic conflict-resolver: a merge decision travestied as syntax reconciliation, no test catches a wrong call.

kilo-mcp-headless-executor.reason: Behavioral contract for Kilo running as the Executor over kilo-mcp — governs the high-volume, spec-driven implementation side.

kilo-mcp-rag-explorer.reason: Read-only semantic search over the codebase index — high volume, low judgment, errors are immediately visible as an irrelevant result.

mcp-metrics-analyst.reason: ROI analysis and defect-pattern review that feeds back into task-spec policy — a wrong conclusion has no downstream check.

mcp-orchestrator.reason: Discovery, isolation, dispatch to kilo_implement, polling, verification, bookkeeping — errors are loud and immediate (a stuck or failed task).
